solution_summary: Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, helping organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, run mission-critical workloads across hybrid cloud, automation, Linux and beyond. But even in a highly data-driven marketing organization, teams trying to answer performance questions and find insights were slowed by fragmented information across dashboards, documents, spreadsheets and internal tools. To solve this, Red Hat built the Marketing Insights and Navigation Engine (MINE) . Powered by an open hybrid cloud foundation ( Red Hat OpenShift ) and integrating Databricks for advanced data engineering and data management, MINE is a marketing intelligence platform that gives marketers seamless access to trusted answers, enabling them to navigate performance data and move from insight to action faster.
business_outcome: Red Hat achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 70% Faster time-to-insight for marketers; Approximately 34,000 Hours saved annually; $1.3M In annual productivity value.
metrics: After running 20 focus groups, the team identified common pain points around dashboard navigation, metric definitions, campaign analysis, and frequently asked questions.
